verdict.rationale: Gitea's core purpose is Git repository hosting with commit browsing, code review, branches, and PR/AGit workflows, confirmed by docs and corroborated by extensive hands-on community usage across many deployments. Minor caveats exist (e.g., slow Activity tab rendering on large repos, some migration difficulties), but the core repo creation/management and commit history browsing capability is well-documented and independently verified. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of commit history browsing performance at scale, and no first-party doc excerpt showing the actual UI/commit log screenshots.
